title: deathframe
summary: The death arc exists: dead-state observation, corpse store tracking, CMSG_REPOP_REQUEST, corpse reclaim with SMSG_CORPSE_RECLAIM_DELAY countdown and Reclaim Corpse button, SMSG_RESURRECT_REQUEST decode with a styled Accept/Decline popup showing caster name and health/mana, and spirit-healer activate on the wire. Durability-loss observation on death is instrumented.

openItems.text: No Release Spirit dialog - RequestRepop is only reachable through the live-run dev protocol ('repop' command in Program.LiveRun.cs); a dead player has no UI button to release, and no release countdown text
No spirit-healer CONFIRM_XP_LOSS confirmation dialog (25% durability / resurrection sickness texts) - SpiritHealerActivate exists on the wire but no UI asks first
Resurrect-request text lacks the reference sickness variants ('...You will be afflicted with resurrection sickness')
